Activists on Hunger Strike for Various Causes, Some Hospitalized

Several individuals and groups across India have initiated hunger strikes to protest various issues, including education reforms and environmental projects. Prominent activist Sonam Wangchuk was forcibly moved to a hospital due to deteriorating health during his hunger strike for education reforms. His family has expressed concerns about his treatment and has set conditions for ending the fast, while other groups are also undertaking similar protests.
